title: Verified artifact reader
responsibility: Reads stored artifact bytes, checks their recorded hash and extracts structured run observations.

inputs.name: artifactBehavior.document
inputs.description: The document value to inspect for recorded run observations. Null, arrays, and other non-object values return null; object fields are normalized into the behavior result.
inputs.unknownReason: The artifact reader must inspect the recorded value to determine whether run observations exist.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.capture
inputs.description: A HarnessCapture with a stored media path or null, the recorded SHA-256, and optional gap text. Null media returns the gap or a missing-artifact message; a stored path has only a leading media/ removed before fetching.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.mediaBase
inputs.description: The prefix for the protected media address, concatenated directly with the capture filename. Include any needed trailing separator because the function does not insert one.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.fetcher
inputs.description: An optional function that receives the resolved media address and returns ok, status, and arrayBuffer. When omitted, it uses (address) => fetch(address).

inputs.name: artifactText.value
inputs.description: The recorded value to turn into display text. Strings pass through, undefined becomes Not recorded, and other values are passed to JSON.stringify with two-space indentation.
inputs.unknownReason: Recorded output can be an arbitrary value and the formatter chooses text after inspecting it.

outputs.name: artifactText
outputs.description: Display text for one recorded value: strings are unchanged, undefined becomes Not recorded, and other values are passed to JSON.stringify with two-space indentation. Cyclic values and BigInt values can make JSON.stringify throw TypeError.

outputs.name: artifactBehavior
outputs.description: Returns null for null, arrays, and primitives; otherwise it returns string scenario/environment/fixture values or null, array-valued steps/assertions/trace, and remaining document fields in other. It selects the first present request key (input, inputs, request) and response key (output, outputs, response, actual); assertion names and pass values are derived from recorded fields, with remaining assertion fields placed in detail.

outputs.name: explorerArtifact
outputs.description: Resolves with response text and parses JSON only after its SHA-256 matches capture.sha256; parsed object documents also receive extracted behavior. Missing media, non-OK HTTP responses, and hash mismatches resolve as unverified artifacts with a problem; mismatched bytes remain text and are not parsed.

examples.problem: The bytes that were read do not have the recorded SHA-256.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: artifactText propagates TypeError from JSON.stringify for cyclic values or BigInt values. The default browser fetch can also reject with TypeError when a request fails.

errors.name: explorerArtifact rejection
errors.description: Rejections from a supplied fetcher, response.arrayBuffer(), or crypto.subtle.digest() propagate unchanged because the reader does not catch them. HTTP non-OK responses and hash mismatches resolve as unverified results instead.
